name: ESP_BIST
help:
Enable the built-in self-test (BIST) feature for the system.
This feature allows for self-diagnosis and verification of system
components during startup or at runtime.

depends on ESP_BIST

name: ESP_BIST_CPU_REG_TEST
help: Enable tests for CPU registers.

name: ESP_BIST_CPU_CSR_REG_TEST
help: Enable tests for CPU Control and Status Registers (CSRs).

name: ESP_BIST_MEMORY_RAM_TEST
help:
Enable tests for the RAM memory integrity (March A, March X, and
Abraham).

name: ESP_BIST_RAM_PARTITION_SIZE
help:
Size of each RAM test partition in 32-bit words. March A/X test one
partition at a time; Abraham tests pairs. Larger values reduce the
number of Abraham pairs C(N,2) and thus the execution time of
bist_ram_test_abraham_full(), at the cost of a larger safe-RAM
backup buffer (2 x partition_size x 4 bytes).

Common values:
256  = 1 KiB partitions, 2 KiB backup buffer (LP core default)
512  = 2 KiB partitions, 4 KiB backup buffer (standalone default)
1024 = 4 KiB partitions, 8 KiB backup buffer

name: ESP_BIST_STACK_TEST
help: Enable tests for the stack integrity.

name: ESP_BIST_PROGRAM_COUNTER_TEST
help: Enable tests for the program counter.

name: ESP_BIST_MEMORY_FLASH_TEST
help: Enable tests for the Flash memory integrity.

name: ESP_BIST_CLOCK_TEST
help: Enable tests for the main crystal clock.

name: ESP_BIST_GPIO_TEST
help: Enable tests for the GPIO pins.

name: ESP_BIST_ADC_TEST
help: Enable tests for the ADC pins.

name: ESP_BIST_WATCHDOG_TEST
help: Enable tests for the HP main watchdog timer (MWDT).

name: ESP_BIST_INTERRUPT_TEST
help: Enable tests for software and hardware interrupts.

name: ESP_BIST_WDT_TIMEOUT_US
help:
Maximum time between watchdog feeds in microseconds.

On the LP core (ESP-IDF ULP integration), this configures the LP WDT
timeout via lp_wdt_init(). On HP core / standalone builds, this configures
the main watchdog timer (MWDT).

name: ESP_BIST_LP_DEBUG_LOG
help:
Compile in ESP_LOGD output on the LP core. Disabled by default to keep
LP firmware small (~16 KiB SRAM).

name: BIST_FLASH_TEST_CHUNK_SIZE
help: Specify the chunk size in bytes for flash memory testing.

name: ESP_BIST_CLOCK_PERCENT_FREQUENCY_DRIFT
help: Specify the acceptable percentage of frequency drift for the clock test.

name: ESP_BIST_ADC_PERCENT_DEVIATION
help:
Specify the acceptable percentage deviation of ADC readings from
the expected low or high reference values for the ADC plausibility tests.

name: ESP_BIST_FLASH_SIZE
help: Specify the size of the flash memory in bytes.

name: ESP_BIST_HEAP_SIZE
help:
Specify the size of the heap in bytes. This is used for dynamic memory allocation
during BIST operations. A value of 0 means no heap is allocated.

name: ESP_BIST_STACK_PROTECTION_BLOCK_SIZE
help:
Specify the size of the stack protection block in bytes. This is used to protect
the stack from overflow and underflow conditions. A value of 0 means no protection
block is allocated.

name: ESP_BIST_WDT_WINDOWED_UNDERFLOW_TIMEOUT_US
help:
Specify the timeout for the windowed underflow condition in microseconds.
This is used to ensure that the watchdog timer does not trigger an underflow
condition during application time-slot.

name: ESP_BIST_METRICS
help:
Enable the collection of performance metrics during BIST operations, such as
execution time, CPU cycles, and instruction counts.

depends on IDF_ESP_BIST_COMPONENT || ZEPHYR_ESP_BIST_MODULE || NUTTX_ESP_BIST_MODULE

name: ESP_BIST_HOST_DIAGNOSTICS
help:
Enable companion supervision of a QM host OS via the Host Diagnostics
agent. The LP companion schedules host audits and
owns safe-state decisions; the host only collaborates.

depends on ESP_BIST_HOST_DIAGNOSTICS

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_QA
help:
Companion issues a challenge; host must answer f(challenge, seq) inside
the configured window.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT
help: Host reports checkpoints; companion tracks set, order, and deadlines.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_RAM
help:
Host runs March tests on an HP DRAM region under companion trigger.
Requires HP linker symbols for the test region and safe stack (later).

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_FLASH
help:
Host computes CRC of HP .flash.text on DIAG_REQ; companion compares
against a build-injected golden. Host PASS alone is never trusted.
Not wired yet (challenge-only Host Diagnostics).

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_CPU
help: Host runs CPU general-purpose register tests under companion trigger.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_CSR
help: Host runs CSR (and related config) diagnostics under companion trigger.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_STACK
help: Host stack integrity check, companion-demandable.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_CLOCK
help:
Clock monitoring for the host time base (FTTI integrity). May use
companion independent time-slot and/or host measurement.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_WDT
help: Host reports armed/feed counters; companion checks the pattern.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_PC
help: Host program-counter / program-flow sample under companion trigger.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_IRQ_LATENCY
help: Companion measures challenge-to-answer latency against a budget.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_GPIO
help:
Critical GPIO plausibility via companion read or host report.
If enabled without an app callback where required, fails NOT_CONFIGURED.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_ADC
help:
Analog / supply plausibility via host or companion ADC when available.
If enabled without an app callback where required, fails NOT_CONFIGURED.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_CONFIG_NVM
help: Host CRC over configured regions; golden from build or provisioning.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_IPC
help: Protocol sequence/CRC enforcement and optional explicit IPC self-check.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_SECURE_BOOT
help: Host reports secure-boot state; companion may gate supervision on it.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AUDIT_DUAL_CHANNEL
help: App-registered compare/cut-off callbacks; library invokes only.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_CHALLENGE_WINDOW_US
help:
Maximum time allowed for the host to answer a Q&A challenge.
Sized from the product FTTI budget.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_DIAG_TIMEOUT_US
help:
Maximum time allowed for the host to complete a companion-triggered
diagnostic (DIAG_REQ → DIAG_RSP).

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AGENT_READY_TIMEOUT_US
help:
Maximum time the companion waits for AGENT_READY after its own BIST before
entering safe state.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AGENT_TASK_STACK
help:
Stack for the high-priority HP thread/task that answers companion
audits. Sized for the deepest enabled audit handler.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AGENT_TASK_PRIO
help:
FreeRTOS priority for the HP agent task. Must outrank application
threads that could otherwise miss the challenge window.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AGENT_THREAD_COOP_PRIO
help:
Cooperative priority index for the HP agent thread, passed to
K_PRIO_COOP(). Lower values rank higher, and the agent must outrank
application threads that could otherwise miss the challenge window.
Must be below CONFIG_NUM_COOP_PRIORITIES.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_AGENT_TASK_PRIO_NUTTX
help:
NuttX SCHED_FIFO priority for the HP agent pthread. Must outrank
application threads that could otherwise miss the challenge window.

name: ESP_BIST_HD_CHALLENGE_KEY
help:
Secret key mixed into bist_hd_challenge_answer(challenge, seq).
Default is for development only; override per product.
